title: Deadwood Solo Open
description: A single-player 3D survival FPS executed entirely in your browser. Defend a forest cabin, survive twenty waves and reach extraction. Published by Nilo. Created with Codex, Claude and Kimi.
controls: Keyboard and mouse or an Xbox-compatible gamepad.
WASD/ZQSD or arrows: move; mouse: look; left click: fire.
Shift: run; C: crouch; Space: jump; R: reload.
1–4 or wheel: weapons; E: interact; V: drop weapon.
G: grenade; B: umbrella; N: next wave.
Esc or P: pause; resume and save from the menu.
credits: Created with Codex, Claude and Kimi.
